test_title: PYST 3: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language. ‘LED' is coded as '15-22-23' and ‘BMW' is coded as '25-14- 4', What is the code for ‘QUF’ in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

Logic: Letters are coded as their opposite letter's place value.

Now,

'LED' is coded as '15-22-23'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f00171fd2cfa7cb1b94b5a297a09645bab1f115bbdab1ec82c7b535a0abc65d5.png] 

'BMW' is coded as '25-14- 4'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a61e3be46185171dd29dd04140a4634a055665d1c5589fe23678050db455567f.png] 

Similarly, for '**QUF**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2df9afc4120faa69a71abe05de22b4e86c29cab57970147de098e7742c60575f.png] 

So, 'QUF' will be coded as '**10-6-21**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
